Subject: Advocate packet: Rohan V — endorsement notes & slot brokering

Hi Marcus + Laura,

Quick context: Rohan V (eng IC, infra team) is ready for a level change to S3. I pulled together a write-up and the supporting evidence pack (attached). He has strong impact on latency work and cross-team ownership; we want to submit the packet to the next leadership committee window.

Asks:
- Marcus/Laura — can you each add 2–3 short advocacy bullets you’d be comfortable saying in the committee? Think specific outcomes (latency % improvement, cross-team projects, mentorship examples).
- Who can present on the call? Marcus volunteered earlier offline — can you confirm? If neither of you can, please suggest an alternate.
- We need to broker a committee slot. Blackout windows from the candidate: 7/22–7/24 (offsite) and 7/29 morning. Ideal target window: 7/27–7/30 (afternoon). I attached availability ICS.

Attachments: ENG-Level-Change-Writeup_RohanV_2026.pdf; Rohan-evidence-pack.zip; calendar-availability.ics

Timeline: I’d like to lock presenter and final advocacy bullets by end of day Monday (7/20) so I can submit to PeopleOps for scheduling.

If helpful, I can draft a 90s speaking script for the presenter.

Thanks — Grace

--
Grace O'Connor
Director, Engineering Management

Grace — thanks for the package. Read through the write-up and the evidence bundle; nice framing. I added a few edits (tracked-changes doc attached) and here are the 3 bullets I’d use in the committee: 

- Engineered the KV shard rebalancer that reduced 99th P99 latency on hot keys by ~18% over Q1–Q2.
- Led cross-team rollout with infra + caching teams; owners now reuse the rollout playbook on two other services.
- Mentored two early ICs into first on-call rotations; owned postmortem improvements to reduce repeat incidents.

I can present but prefer an afternoon slot on 7/28 or 7/29 (post 1pm PT). If those aren't available, Laura can present and I’ll back her up. Attached: ENG-Level-Change-Writeup_RohanV_2026_trackchanges.docx
